latestVersion.changelog:
Video Generator Free From Image — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: Quickly turn your images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) into animated video clips with music, no editing experience required.
- Cloud-based rendering — no downloads or installs needed; results ready in 30–60 seconds per video.
- Automatic setup: Instantly handles connection, session, and free token provisioning for new users.
- Natural language control: "Turn my image into a short", "add music", "export MP4", etc.
- Multi-language and multi-format support for both uploads and exports (video, audio, image formats).
- Error handling and session management built-in for a seamless experience.
